messages:
maria: RC ready for origination — candidate sha abcdef123456, includes kv-cache OOM fix + tiny batcher perf tweak. Quiet window: 2026-03-22 02:00–04:00 UTC. Need ops sign-off, pin, and sheriff for promo. @tim @sara

tim: looked at the diff, lgtm for runtime. Any DB migrations?

maria: no schema changes. There is a config flag (softfreezer.enabled) we flip in-flight. We'll ship with flag off and flip during promo.

sara: smoke tests on staging passed 3/3. I uploaded perf traces: https://ci.redwood/demo/trace/65789

jordan: deploy-bot, can you originate RC and pin artifact abcdef123456 to rc-2026-03-22?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] received: originate-request sha=abcdef123456 env=rc tag=rc-2026-03-22 requested_by=maria
deploy-bot: preflight checks: artifacts found, staging-smoke=PASS, canary-health=PASS, kv-warm=OK

oncall-sre: I'll be sheriff for the promo window. Will be online 01:30–05:00 UTC. Add me to pager rotation.

ben: rollback plan: if errors > 5% latency degradation or 3xx/5xx spike, revert to rc-previous and flip softfreezer back off. Handled by rollback script: `scripts/rollback_to_rc.sh rc-previous`

maria: pin request: ops please pin rc-2026-03-22. Also add a hold marker on any hotpatch merges until promo completes.

jordan: pinned artifact rc-2026-03-22 -> abcdef123456 :pushpin:

deploy-bot: origination complete. Release notes draft: "kv-cache OOM mitigation; batcher latency improvements; softfreezer config added (off by default)." Link: https://go/release-notes/rc-2026-03-22

tim: quick checklist before promo: 1) DB migrations none ✔ 2) KV warm -> done ✔ 3) Telemetry alerts configured (latency, error-rate) ✔ 4) Rollback script tested ✔

sara: can someone run the final smoke in prod shadow? I can kick it now.

oncall-sre: running shadow smoke now -> 8/8 checks PASS. Observability dashboards seeded.

maria: ok green. Ops sign-off? @oncall-sre @jordan @ben

oncall-sre: sign-off from oncall. Ready to lift 02:00 UTC.

jordan: ops sign-off from infra. Quiet window set and hold created.

ben: signed off for rollback readiness. I'll monitor and be ready to execute rollback if alerts trip.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll trigger the promote at 02:00 UTC and call the lift here. Will post updates in this thread. :rocket:
